newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offers 8 discount T-bill issues March 4-7.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offers 8 discount T-bill issues March 4-7.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry will offer eight issues of discount T-bills with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance at auctions this week, the central bank said.
Half of the issues have a maturity of one week and the rest have a four-week maturity. Auction dates and issue dates for each issue overlap.
ISSUE NUMBER ISSUE DATE MATURITY DATE
The ministry started to issue short-term T-bills daily on January 20 to drain excessive banks' liquidity and the central bank suspended daily reverse repo auctions with repurchase of over two days.

This was in line with preparations for the introduction of a restrictive monetary regime, the currency board system, proposed by the International Monetary Fund under which central bank open market operations would be curbed.
